root_cause: In werkzeug/sansio/utils.py the function host_is_trusted extracts the hostname from the request using a regex group, leaving bracketed IPv6 literals intact (e.g., '[::1]'), but then processes each trusted entry by cutting off everything after the first colon via ref.partition(':')[0] (line 72). This turns a trusted entry like '[::1]' into '[' causing a mismatch and returning False.
